# Launch Screen Assets

These images are generated from `brand/lunaway-mark.svg` by
`tool/brand/generate.sh` (the mark on a cream disc). Edit the source and run
the script rather than replacing them by hand.

The launch screen is navy with this image in every theme: the app turns
dark after sunset whatever the system says, and a cream launch screen then
flashed before a dark map. Only the dark image is used; the script's light
image is not part of the set.
